glosses: eagle (any of several large carnivorous birds in the family Accipitridae)
eagle (representation of such an eagle (bird) carried as an emblem)
eagle (representation of such a bird on a coat of arms)

examples.text: Uma águia está voando no céu.
examples.en: An eagle is flying in the sky.

examples.text: A águia está prestes a pousar.
examples.en: The eagle is about to land.

examples.text: A águia é a rainha das aves.
examples.en: The eagle is the king of birds.
